hero.title: Bhagwant University, Ajmer
hero.summary: Bhagwant University, Ajmer offers full-time on-campus agriculture programmes in Ajmer, Rajasthan through its Faculty of Agriculture, featuring experimental crop plots, soil and plant protection laboratories, and Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE).

overview.heading: Agricultural education at Bhagwant University, Ajmer (Faculty of Agriculture)
paragraphs: Bhagwant University, Ajmer operates its dedicated Faculty of Agriculture at Ajmer, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test). Semi-arid central Rajasthan crop research farm on Sikar Road (Ajmer), farm machinery workshop, irrigation engineering lab and soil testing unit. Candidates comparing private agriculture universities in Rajasthan should verify both state JET counselling seat matrices and cohort-specific statutory accreditation terms before locking their choice.

admissions.heading: Admission process and eligibility at Bhagwant University, Ajmer
admissions.intro: Admission to agriculture programmes at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is conducted through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test), alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates.
admissions.route_scope: Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting.
eligibility_points: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture: 10+2 with Agriculture or PCB / PCM with minimum 45% marks.
B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM) or Agriculture with minimum 45% marks.
M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy): 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture from a recognized university.

steps.title: Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window
steps.text: Register through the official Bhagwant University, Ajmer admissions portal (https://bhagwantuniversity.ac.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling.

steps.title: Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details
steps.text: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate.

steps.title: Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation
steps.text: Verify original documents on campus at Ajmer and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

documents: Class X mark sheet and certificate (date of birth proof).
Class XII mark sheet and passing certificate with Agriculture / PCB / PCM.
Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG / CUET / University entrance rank card.
Domicile and Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS where applicable).
Aadhaar card, ABC/APAAR ID and 6 passport-size photographs.

campus.heading: Experimental farms, laboratories and RAWE at Ajmer
campus.intro: Semi-arid central Rajasthan crop research farm on Sikar Road (Ajmer), farm machinery workshop, irrigation engineering lab and soil testing unit.

facilities.name: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm
facilities.description: Field demonstration plots at Ajmer for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises.

facilities.name: Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab
facilities.description: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing.

facilities.name: Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit
facilities.description: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space.

facilities.name: Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs
facilities.description: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment.

facilities.name: Student Hostels, Library & Transport
facilities.description: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Ajmer, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

practical_learning: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year.
Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production.
Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and fee concessions at Bhagwant University, Ajmer
scholarships.text: Bhagwant University, Ajmer offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students.

schemes.name: University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27)
schemes.details: Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance.

schemes.name: Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive
schemes.details: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

placements.heading: Agribusiness career support, internships and higher study
placements.text: The placement and training cell at Bhagwant University, Ajmer coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations.
statistics: Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.
recruiters: Agri-input, seed & crop-care companies across Rajasthan and North India
Agri-warehousing, organic certification & rural banking / microfinance institutions

recognition.heading: Statutory recognition, Rajasthan JET & accreditation scope
recognition.text: Bhagwant University, Ajmer is established by an Act of the Rajasthan State Legislature and recognized under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. Its Faculty of Agriculture runs B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering and M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) following the ICAR 5th Deans’ Committee syllabus. Applicants should verify whether their specific cohort requires state Rajasthan JET counselling vs direct ICAR List-II programme accreditation.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture fee at Bhagwant University, Ajmer for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The published annual tuition fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is INR 65,000 per year. Confirm hostel, examination and registration charges separately.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Sc. Agriculture at Bhagwant University, Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Admission is offered through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test) for candidates who have passed 10+2 with Agriculture, PCB, PCM or PCA.

faqs.question: Where is the agriculture campus of Bhagwant University, Ajmer located?
faqs.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture is located at Sikar Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004, India.

faqs.question: What practical farm facilities are available at Bhagwant University, Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Semi-arid central Rajasthan crop research farm on Sikar Road (Ajmer), farm machinery workshop, irrigation engineering lab and soil testing unit.

faqs.question: Does Bhagwant University, Ajmer offer M.Sc. Agriculture or postgraduate courses?
faqs.answer: Covered programmes include: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (4 years); B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering (4 years); M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) (2 years).
